compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for adding an email account. It provides a list of popular email service providers that users can choose from to add their email account. The options include:

1. my.com
2. Google
3. Yahoo!
4. Outlook
5. Windows Live Hotmail
6. Exchange
7. AOL
8. QQ.com

At the bottom, there is an option labeled "OTHER MAIL" for adding email accounts from other providers not listed above. The screen has a simple and clean design with a background image of mountains.
